fieldValues.title: Negative test for check-programme-conformance.mjs (srs#667)
fieldValues.summary: Added the missing negative test for check-programme-conformance.mjs's two assertions (srs#667). While validating this unit's own gates, misdiagnosed a shallow local git clone as a rewritten master history (srs#668) and briefly shipped an incorrect allowlist fix; caught by CI's own full-history checkout, retracted, and reverted in the same PR before merge.
fieldValues.body:
srs#667: added a root-override argument to check-programme-conformance.mjs (mirroring every sibling check-*-cell.mjs), and a new tests/guards/run.mjs case copying the real programme/ tree, breaking each of the check's two assertions in turn (emptied .srs marker; a record with a dangling typeId reference), asserting red with the offending message, then restoring and asserting green.

srs#668 (filed, then retracted): initially diagnosed scripts/versioning-cell-allowlist.json's one commit-pinned entry as stale after a 'master history rewrite', because two commits it cites (3553f2ac, 72c5d2b7) looked absent/non-ancestor from this session's local clone. That clone was shallow -- git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository was never checked before drawing the conclusion. After `git fetch --unshallow`, both commits resolved correctly and the original allowlist entry was confirmed correct all along; the emptied-allowlist push was reverted before merge. See finding 07d153cf for the durable lesson.
